description: This file defines the LinkingController class, a React component controller that manages linking notes, files, and tags within a web application. It handles operations such as linking, unlinking, activating items, and managing UI state related to linking panels.

classes.name: LinkingController
classes.description: A controller managing the linking operations between notes, files, and tags within the web application, including UI state management and item association logic.

methods.name: setServicesPostConstruction
methods.description: Sets controller services after construction for item list, files, and subscription management.

methods.name: get isEntitledToNoteLinking
methods.description: Returns whether the current subscription entitles note linking.

methods.name: setIsLinkingPanelOpen
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of the linking panel UI.

methods.name: activeItem
methods.description: Returns the currently active item object from the application.

methods.name: getFilesLinksForItem
methods.description: Retrieves files linked to and linking to a given item.

methods.name: getLinkedTagsForItem
methods.description: Retrieves tags linked to a given item.

methods.name: getLinkedNotesForItem
methods.description: Retrieves notes linked to a given item.

methods.name: getNotesLinkingToItem
methods.description: Retrieves notes referencing the given item.

methods.name: activateItem
methods.description: Activates and opens the specified item, possibly changing UI navigation state.

methods.name: unlinkItemFromSelectedItem
methods.description: Unlinks a specified item from the first selected item.

methods.name: ensureActiveItemIsInserted
methods.description: Ensures that the active item is inserted into the editor or view.

methods.name: linkItems
methods.description: Links two items together with type-specific logic.

methods.name: linkItemToSelectedItem
methods.description: Links the active item to a specified item.

methods.name: createAndAddNewTag
methods.description: Creates a new tag with the given title and adds it to the active item.

methods.name: addTagToItem
methods.description: Associates a tag with a specific item (note or file).
